summary: Completed focused backend and browser regression testing for live weather, WMO mapping, notification copy, location search, recommendations, forecasts, and mobile behavior. Prior WMO-0 and unsupported-alert regressions are resolved.
seed_data_creation: Created one TEST_mausam_review status record through the existing persistence regression test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: WMO 0 maps to sunny/Clear sky and WMO 95 maps to storm/Thunderstorm. Live Rajahmundry and Hyderabad weather use source open-meteo; hourly and daily arrays contain 24 and 7 rows. Notification panel shows current source condition and explicitly says official IMD warnings/UV are not connected. Mobile 390px has no horizontal overflow and navigation works after closing the notification popover.
rca of the issue: Iteration 6 defects were caused by truthiness fallback replacing WMO code 0 with 3, and hard-coded notification claims for unsupported heavy-rain/UV advisories. Current condition_for uses an explicit None check and the notification panel uses source condition plus unavailable-integration copy. AQI/UV/pollen/tide/wave/official IMD warning values remain MOCKED/UNAVAILABLE integration-ready placeholders, fallback weather is MOCKED only when Open-Meteo fails, and the map radar is a visual placeholder.
